profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading as META with CIK 0001326801. Its most recent 10-K reports revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. On its developer site at llama.com, the company describes build tools for AI developers, including Muse Spark accessible through Muse Code and Meta Model API. The site says the model is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals.

The site states that developers can make a first working request in under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at Meta Model API, and can add search grounding to give a model live web access. Meta's AI product line includes Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. MCP server listings associated with Meta include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, ai.fastmetal/fastmetal, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, ai.primeta/primeta, app.metadock/metadock, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, and com.adbloop/meta-ads.

Meta Platforms, Inc. is named as a defendant in Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in District Court, W.D. Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in District Court, N.D. California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in U.S. District Court, N.D. California. A California law exposure entry lists 281 items.
